description: Geolocation and network info for any IP address (e.g., "8.8.8.8"): city, region, country, coordinates, postal code, timezone, plus ownership fields -- ASN, owner name, network range and owner domain -- each with its source (null with a reason when no source states it). For "which company owns this IP" call rdap_ip, which is the registry source for those fields; this tool adds geolocation.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up (e.g., "8.8.8.8")

name: ipinfo_lookup_ip
